conclusion: The MISEV2023 guidance (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports the need for orthogonal characterization, validated intact‑EV assays (fit‑for‑purpose: LLOQ, specificity, precision), separation from non‑vesicular particles, stability‑indicating potency assays, and transparent production reporting prior to high‑confidence cross‑species PK/PD comparisons. The supplied evidence does NOT provide any program‑specific CMC, assay validation, scale‑up, or GLP biodistribution data for SGL‑001; therefore program‑level claims that these elements are already in place are unsupported by the provided evidence.
unsupported_assertions: SGL-001 currently meets MISEV2023-recommended orthogonal QC and validated intact‑EV assay criteria (LLOQ, specificity, precision).
Master Cell Bank (MCB) and Working Cell Bank (WCB) generation and characterization exist for SGL-001.
Stability‑indicating, mechanism‑linked potency assay has been developed for SGL-001 and correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint.
≥3 GMP-like scale‑up runs with release, stability, and potency results demonstrating lot‑to‑lot reproducibility have been completed for SGL-001.
Formulation/device compatibility with intact‑EV recovery has been demonstrated ex vivo and in vivo for SGL-001.
GLP large‑animal intranasal biodistribution/toxicity studies with intact‑EV analytics have been completed for SGL-001.
